newsitem.title: USA: Net Lnnx merger cancelled, other sought.
newsitem.headline: Net Lnnx merger cancelled, other sought.

text.p: Net Lnnx Inc said Thursday that its proposed merger with Techni-Logic Consultants Inc had been cancelled.

"After completing the due diligence process, the company determined that the initial agreed upon merger terms were not feasable," the company said. "The merger would not be fair for the shareholders since TLC has had declining net earnings from year end 1996, and upon the conclusion of our due diligence, we made a fair offer which was not accepted by TLC."
The company said it is considering several other potential candidates in its search of a viable merger.
